Пять этапов моей жизни и путь к MARKOVMA: Five stages of my life and the path to MARKOVMADE. Sport, work, difficult periods, and personal experience shaped an approach for everyday life.
В 13 лет я запустил первый бизнес по дро: At 13, I started my first dropshipping business and created a healthy-living community in my town. At 14, I played professional football and was called up to the national team. Bullying, corruption, and an injury ended that chapter. I focused on training and personal growth, then created the Young Athlete brand and Markov Made Mafia community.
С 17 до 20 лет я участвовал в соревнован: From 17 to 20, I competed in bodybuilding, moved to St. Petersburg, and worked for Sport Life. I studied medicine and marketing, appeared on Dom-2, and launched a dental clinic and a hookah business. By 20, I had saved 5.5 million and built a large audience.
В 21 год предательство близкого друга и: At 21, a close friend and business partner betrayed me, leaving me with a debt of 1.5 million rubles. I sold my assets, left social media, and went through severe depression. Then I moved to China. During the year I spent there, I learned the basics of the language, worked as a model, and placed in international competitions. Living in another country helped me start over.
После возвращения в Россию я создал аген: After returning to Russia, I founded BrandYouMade and continued studying psychology, sales, and marketing. I worked in a leadership role in Sochi real estate and spoke at Blockchain Life to an audience of 12,000. This experience brought together my work with people, teams, and business.
Мой опыт спорта, бизнеса, финансовых тру: My experience in sport, business, financial hardship, and personal change led me to create MARKOVMADE. I make digital products that help people understand themselves and their daily decisions.
Сегодня я развиваю MARKOVMADE и продолжа: Today, I continue to build MARKOVMADE and work as an ambassador. My Pomeranian is by my side. Everything I have been through remains part of my story.
